name: Hiizumi Huuki
source:
"Indeed, I am Huuki Hiizumi. By some strange twist of fate, I am now joined in this form. I look forward to meeting you all."

Another Luden created by [url=/c160583]ARATA[/url]. Formed using data from Clea Glaive, a certain someone's memories, and the thoughts of Kaede Hiizumi's mother. She's essentially a living spirit. Fittingly, the data from Claire seemed to resonate with her more than with Kaede.

She resembles her source: powerful, righteous, and brave. Though her personality clashes with ARATA's, she honors the fact that he created her and fights for him. Not the smartest decision, in my opinion. If [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] can appeal to her sense of honor, the tides may turn.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category9&ch=huuki]official website[/url]]
